info.name: SolarSelect frozen and verified champion API
info.description: Set model_source=local or mlflow to match the explicitly configured running service. Registry mode only supports primary_extra_trees.

exec: pm.test('Selected source ready', function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('READY'); pm.expect(b.model_source).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('model_source') || 'local'); });

pm.test('Selected provider', function () { const b=pm.response.json(); const source=pm.collectionVariables.get('model_source') || 'local'; pm.expect(b.source).to.eql(source); pm.expect(b.units).to.eql('kWh/kWp/day'); if (source==='mlflow') { pm.expect(b.registered_name).to.eql('SolarSelect-Yield-PeerCohort'); pm.expect(b.registered_version).to.eql('1'); pm.expect(b.registered_alias).to.eql('champion'); } });
pm.test('Explicit variant policy', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(registry ? 409 : 200); if (registry) pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('MODEL_VARIANT_NOT_ENABLED'); });
